练唱 · singing

A reusable Skill for turning a chosen song into a practical loop: find usable accompaniment and synchronized lyrics, record a separate vocal take, return it for listening, and compare a meaningful phrase with the actual reference audio. Feedback connects pitch, timing, diction, and expression to a concrete next attempt. It does not require a fixed curriculum or assume a singer's range.

Copy the complete singing/ directory into the Skill location supported by your agent host. Start with SKILL.md. Example request: “Help me practice this chorus using my reference and microphone take; return the recording and show where the entrances differ.” The host must actually support the requested audio access, media playback, or application operation; installing this package does not supply those capabilities.

Dependency or composition Role and acquisition
Required supporting Skills None; the singing method is contained here.
Optional research Investigate accompaniment sources; download its complete package if needed. Singing retains audition and practice judgment.
Optional Yinyang Broader user/model relationship; download its complete package if wanted. No private portrait is included or required.
Python 3.9+ Required only for the bundled WAV checker; obtain from Python.
Recorder/DAW, audio playback, optional analysis tools Required according to the requested operation, supplied by your host; routes and upstream links are in the tool guide.

Download linked Skill directories through the repository's native source archive or clone, retaining each complete package and its license.

The tool guide describes supplied-file use, optional FFmpeg, analysis libraries, and a separately installed Logic Pro/MCP route. The comparison guide explains evidence limits. The read-only WAV checker needs Python 3.9+ only:

python3 scripts/check_wav.py /path/to/take.wav

It checks integer PCM WAV integrity and signal metrics; it does not listen, record, extract pitch, or score singing. Use your own recorder/DAW and authorized media. Keep raw takes, personal preferences, account details, and library records in your own session storage. Free viewing does not grant media redistribution.

This is a portable adaptation of an author-maintained local singing workflow. Private singer profiles, attributable personal records, recordings, host paths, credentials, and machine-specific integration receipts are excluded. Original package prose and code are MIT licensed. No third-party code or media is bundled; linked tools and acquired music retain their respective rights.
